title: Care Home Finance: Why Charge Counts and Financing Events Tell Different Stories
author: Matt Lenzie
abstract: This descriptive research note examines how the choice of activity measure changes the reading of care-home finance in England and Wales. Using seven published aggregate rows from the Care Home Finance Report 2026, it reproduces nine matched-period changes and seven charge-to-event ratios. H1 2026 charges fell 3.3%, while financing events rose 0.2% and borrowing companies rose 0.6%. Charges per event fell from 2.136 to 2.062. The note explains the counting units, overlapping observation windows and limits of aggregate reproduction. Counts do not establish loan amounts, pricing or credit availability. This is a secondary analysis of Care Homes Finance research, not an independent survey. Source and methodology: https://carehomesfinance.co.uk/reports/care-home-finance-2026/ Contact: enquiries@carehomesfinance.co.uk.
